title: OpenEdit motion graphics for a YouTube intro
prompt_text:
/open-edit Add motion graphics to my YouTube intro, following my yt-motion-graphics-style.

Process:

1. Transcribe the video, identify cut points, and review my asset library at `~/Documents/ASSETS/OPENEDIT`. Present a beat-by-beat storyboard showing time range, spoken line, and what appears on screen. List any open decisions as a short numbered list. Wait for my approval before proceeding.

2. Show me style frames before the full render.

3. Render at the source video's original resolution and frame rate, with sound effects mixed underneath my original voice.

Hard rules:
- Preserve the exact video length and original footage. No camera moves, zooms, shakes, colour grading, black-and-white effects, or letterbox bars. All visual energy must come from motion graphics.
- Follow VEED branding: Electric Lime `#96FF1A` as the only accent colour, `#121212` instead of pure black, no red, and no gradients. Use lime exclusively for emphasis.
- Use SwissNow Medium for all text. No other fonts.
- Use keyword titles only, not captions. Large titles should appear behind me using a cutout effect, stacked and left-aligned, with every word clearly readable.
- No pill or chip labels, REC indicators, timecodes, viewfinder overlays, or reticle boxes around my face. Use my animated arrow asset for list bullets.
- Prioritise concrete visual metaphors for abstract ideas, such as a grid representing a "sea of sameness," rather than generic cards.
- Use authentic platform logos in white.
- Generate AI imagery and sound effects using fal. Quote the total estimated cost in one line before spending anything.

Final deliverables:
- OTIO timeline and Premiere XML
- Graphics-only layers with alpha transparency, exported separately for behind-me and in-front elements
- SFX-only audio stem

title: Pomeranians crash a warehouse martial arts fight
prompt_text:
🎬 Long Cinematic AI Video Prompt

Create an ultra-realistic, high-energy Hollywood-style martial arts action video set inside a विशाल, dark industrial warehouse with towering concrete pillars, exposed metal beams, dusty floors, broken wooden crates, scattered debris, and dramatic overhead lights cutting through the darkness. The atmosphere feels intense and cinematic, with floating dust particles, deep shadows, realistic reflections, and powerful action-movie cinematography.

At the center of the warehouse, several muscular adult male fighters wearing black tactical outfits, dark trousers, combat boots, and fingerless gloves are engaged in an extraordinary martial arts battle. Suddenly, a group of tiny, adorable, fluffy Pomeranian dogs with thick cream, white, and golden-brown fur enters the fighting area. Their cute appearance creates a hilarious contrast with the serious, intimidating fighters.

The action begins when one muscular fighter charges forward and throws a powerful punch at his opponent. The opponent quickly ducks, performs a spinning kick, and jumps backward. At that exact moment, a tiny fluffy Pomeranian runs between their legs, completely ignoring the chaos. The camera follows the dog in a dramatic low-angle tracking shot as it sprints across the dusty floor while the fighters continue their intense battle in the background.

Another fighter performs an impressive jumping kick, rotating through the air in slow motion. A small Pomeranian suddenly runs beneath him, its fluffy fur bouncing naturally with every step. The fighter lands heavily on the floor, sending a cloud of dust into the air, while the dog stops briefly, looks around innocently, and continues running as if nothing happened.

The battle becomes increasingly spectacular as multiple fighters perform fast punches, defensive blocks, spinning kicks, evasive movements, and acrobatic jumps. Two fighters exchange rapid martial arts combinations while another performs a dramatic backward dodge. Meanwhile, the little dogs weave between the fighters, dodge their movements, run around their feet, and occasionally pause to tilt their heads curiously at the commotion.

In the next sequence, one fighter attempts an elaborate spinning kick while another jumps sideways to avoid it. A fluffy golden Pomeranian races across the foreground, its tiny paws moving rapidly against the concrete floor. The camera switches between wide cinematic shots showing the entire warehouse, close-ups of the fighters' intense facial expressions, and ground-level shots capturing the dogs' adorable reactions. The action remains playful and non-graphic, with no blood or visible injuries.

As the intensity increases, the fighters move through different parts of the warehouse, leaping over obstacles, sliding across the floor, and executing coordinated martial arts maneuvers. The Pomeranians remain the unexpected stars of the scene, running confidently through the action and creating amusing moments whenever the fighters narrowly miss stepping near them. One tiny dog sits beside a fallen wooden crate, watching two fighters exchange movements before suddenly jumping up and running toward the camera.

For the climax, the remaining fighters prepare for one final dramatic showdown in the middle of the warehouse. They charge toward each other, execute synchronized spinning kicks, and leap into the air as the camera circles around them in a spectacular 360-degree cinematic movement. Suddenly, several fluffy Pomeranians run together across the center of the scene, distracting everyone. The fighters stop in surprise and look down at the tiny dogs, creating a hilarious contrast between their intimidating appearance and the dogs' innocent expressions.

Finish with a cinematic slow-motion shot of the Pomeranians running happily toward the camera while the fighters stand in the background, exhausted and confused. The camera moves closer to the lead Pomeranian as its fluffy ears bounce and its little paws kick up tiny clouds of dust. End with a dramatic wide shot of the warehouse, the fighters standing motionless, and the adorable dogs confidently walking away like the true champions of the battle.

Visual style: Photorealistic characters, highly detailed fluffy fur, realistic dog anatomy and movement, professional martial arts choreography, physically believable motion, cinematic lighting, volumetric dust, dramatic camera angles, smooth tracking shots, rapid action cuts, realistic shadows, subtle motion blur, and carefully timed slow-motion sequences.

Technical specifications: Ultra-realistic 4K cinematic quality, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, fluid animation, consistent dog appearances throughout all scenes, natural facial expressions, detailed warehouse environments, immersive action-movie atmosphere, humorous storytelling, no blood, no graphic violence, no text, no subtitles, and no watermark.

title: Heavy-lift rocket launch heard from the marsh, 6-shot 30s prompt
prompt_text: Video prompt / A heavy-lift rocket tears off a coastal launch pad at first light, and the marsh three kilometres away only hears it long after the vehicle has climbed out of frame. Shot 1 - 0.0s to 5.0s - EWS, low angle looking up from the marsh edge, locked-off; the launch pad fills the far frame, and the first five seconds are only the low rumble travelling through reeds as the vehicle rises. Shot 2 - 5.0s to 10.0s - MCU, handheld, the ignition deluge and steam; the pre-laced marsh-channel water sheets the near bank and the deluge pipe mouth in the near foreground stays almost dry. Shot 3 - 10.0s to 15.0s - MS, crane, the hold-down release and the stack clearing the tower; the crane tracks the vehicle just enough to keep it centred while the marsh drops away to a flat horizon. Shot 4 - 15.0s to 20.0s - EWS, drone high angle looking down on the marsh; the launch pad is a bright point in the distance and the sound still has not reached the reeds. Shot 5 - 20.0s to 25.0s - WS, locked-off on the marsh edge again; the delayed sound finally arrives as a soft pressure wave that ripples the reed beds, a single bird lifting off to the east. Shot 6 - 25.0s to 30.0s - EWS, slow dolly east over the marsh as the vehicle threads the cloud base; the scene holds on the flat wetland and the distant contrail. Camera: 35mm anamorphic throughout, 2.39:1, 24 fps, 180 degree motion blur, natural colour profile with a restrained contrast curve. Anti-default: the near-foreground deluge pipe stays almost dry, and the marsh water does not sheet or ripple from engine wash at any point until shot five. Grade: gold-hour amber palette over the launch pad with sulphur / wet concrete grey / one white plume in the upper frame, the marsh in cool desaturated teal and the sky holding a clean blue gradient. Audio: five diegetic events — (1) the low sub rumble arriving through ground and reeds before anything is seen, (2) the ignition and deluge hiss in shot two, (3) the hold-down release and stack-clear clank in shot three, (4) the distant steady thrust tone in shots four and six, (5) the delayed soft pressure-wave arrival rippling the reeds in shot five with one bird call. Constraints: 6 shots, zero people visible, one visible vehicle (the rocket, no ground vehicles), one bird in shot five only, zero logos / insignia / lettering / text, no music or score or BGM, no subtitles, no voiceover.
